justification: DB data migration + single code file change affecting Inner West DCP structured controls display. Standard because: data fix to 39 rows in one table, one-line code change, no new logic paths, but affects production data immediately.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — 39 rows with lga='inner_west' (29 deactivated, 10 migrated to correct former council slugs, 5 placeholder rows deactivated)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a former council slug is missing controls that only existed under inner_west, those controls disappear. Verified: all 36 legitimate rows mapped to a target council. 26 car parking rows were duplicates of better data already under former council slugs.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to existing rows only. UPDATE lga on 10 rows, SET is_current=false on 34 rows. Code change prevents future inner_west queries.

functions.name: getLgaSlugs
functions.output: string[] of LGA slugs for SQL IN clause
functions.if_none: falls through to [normalized] — single slug lookup, correct behavior

values.nullable: yes — undefined if not in map

queries.purpose: Fetch structured controls for a council + dev_type
queries.where_clause: WHERE sc.lga IN ($1) AND sc.dev_type = $2 AND (sc.is_current IS NULL OR sc.is_current = true)
queries.if_zero: returns has_controls: false with empty categories — correct
queries.if_wrong: previously returned cross-council data due to inner_west LGA slug; now fixed by migrating data to correct slugs and removing inner_west from mapping

break_it.scenario: New inner_west rows added in future without former council scoping
break_it.what_happens: They sit under lga='inner_west' but are never queried (no mapping exists)
break_it.how: Code comment at route.ts:20-25 explains migration. Future data entry should use former council slugs directly.
break_it.repro: INSERT INTO dcp_setback_controls (lga, ...) VALUES ('inner_west', ...) then GET /api/dcp/structured-controls?council=ashfield

break_it.what_happens: Would show duplicate or fabricated junk data in the UI
break_it.how: route.ts:143 — WHERE clause includes AND (sc.is_current IS NULL OR sc.is_current = true)
break_it.repro: SELECT * FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE id IN (641, 642, 1134) AND is_current = true — should return 0 rows

break_it.scenario: Non-Inner-West council queries return different results after code change
break_it.what_happens: Other councils see wrong or missing data in DCP controls
break_it.how: COUNCIL_TO_LGA is now empty — all councils fall through to [normalized] single-slug lookup, same behavior as before for all 25+ non-Inner-West councils
break_it.repro: GET /api/dcp/structured-controls?council=waverley — should return same results as before

break_it.scenario: Query returns zero rows for a former council that previously had inner_west controls
break_it.what_happens: DCP tab shows 'no structured controls' instead of the expected numeric values
break_it.how: Verified via DB query: ashfield has 8 controls, marrickville has 11, leichhardt has 10 after migration. All migrated rows confirmed present under correct slugs.
break_it.repro: GET /api/dcp/structured-controls?council=ashfield&dev_type=dwelling_house — should return has_controls: true with 8 controls

post_merge.db_reset: No — DB changes already applied to production
